t: These two curved blocks are Kensal House, a housing estate of 68 flats at the northern end of Ladbroke Grove in Kensal Green. It was completed in 1937 and designed by the architect Maxwell Fry, an English modernist who also wrote and painted. It was the first modernist block in the UK designed for working-class residents, and on completion it was widely thought to be a prototype for modern living. Today the flats are run by a housing association.
